presets.name: Classic 80s clean chorus
presets.desc: Single BBD voice, smoothed triangle at 0.8 Hz, wet as loud as dry: deep, warm warble on clean arpeggios

refs.why: Andy Summers' chorus-and-flanger swirl on clean arpeggiated chords

presets.notes: The CE-2 reference (VOICING §6): 50/50 resistor mix = mix 1.0 in the Add law, BBD with emphasis from the profile

presets.name: Synth chorus I
presets.desc: Two 256-stage BBD voices in anti-phase at 0.51 Hz: gentle stereo shimmer that widens pads and polysynth chords

refs.why: Juno-60 layer in the keyboard part, chorus mode on

presets.notes: Measured Juno-60 mode I rate and swing (pendragon-andyh); Keys profile keeps the hiss and drops emphasis like the original

presets.name: Synth chorus II
presets.desc: The same two anti-phase BBD voices at 0.86 Hz: faster, more animated stereo movement on pads and strings
presets.notes: Measured Juno-60 mode II rate; same depth as mode I per the measurement (Arturia says deeper)

presets.name: Synth chorus I+II shimmer
presets.desc: One mono BBD voice at 9.75 Hz with a 0.4 ms swing: a fast, glassy shimmer close to vibrato
presets.notes: Both Juno buttons pressed: measured fast mono mode, tiny swing so the pitch flutters rather than bends

presets.name: Synth-style stereo clean guitar
presets.desc: Juno-type anti-phase stereo voices on a clean guitar: wide, glossy chords that sit beside synth pads
presets.notes: Guitar Clean profile filters (80 Hz to 8 kHz wet) with the Juno topology; warmth 40 opens the top a little

presets.name: Wide still thickener 1
presets.desc: Two complementary companded voices, cross-mixed: width and thickness with almost no audible pitch wobble
presets.notes: Dimension button 1: longest centre delay, subtlest; an always-on spread rather than an effect

presets.name: Wide still thickener 2
presets.desc: Complementary companded voices at half the delay: a tighter, slightly brighter stereo spread without wobble
presets.notes: Dimension button 2: delay about half of mode 1 (manual), same slow rate

presets.name: Wide still thickener 3
presets.desc: Complementary voices with double swing at 0.5 Hz: the most obvious Dimension, still smooth and mono-solid
presets.notes: Dimension button 3: delay between modes 1 and 2, depth doubled (manual)

presets.name: Wide still keys
presets.desc: Dimension-style complementary voices on electric piano, synth or organ: stereo width with the pitch kept still
presets.notes: Keys profile: lows under 100 Hz stay dry and mono, so the left hand stays centred

presets.name: Wide still vocal
presets.desc: Dimension-style voices on a lead or backing vocal at a low mix: width and air, no seasick pitch
presets.notes: Voice profile: clean engine, wet low-cut 150 Hz, mono-safe, wet ducked on syllable attacks

presets.name: High-gain stereo widener
presets.desc: After a high-gain amp: Dimension width on the mids, lows dry and mono, wet ducked on attacks so chugs stay tight
presets.notes: Guitar Drive profile: crossover 150 Hz, wet 250 Hz to 5 kHz, env_mix -30 %; place after amp and cab

presets.name: Stereo clean intro chorus
presets.desc: Bright BBD chorus spread hard left-right on a clean arpeggio before the distorted section hits

refs.why: clean intro through a stereo amp chorus (JC-120 style)

presets.notes: Stereo Custom: opposite LFOs and 130 % wet width mimic a stereo amp chorus; warmth 35 keeps it bright like a solid-state clean

presets.name: Watery grunge chorus
presets.desc: Deep, fairly fast BBD warble on a clean or edge-of-breakup riff: liquid, slightly seasick low strings

refs.why: Small Clone chorus with the depth switch in on the intro riff

presets.notes: Depth 7 ms and 1.3 Hz push past the CE-2 into a deeper, wetter warble; warmth 60 darkens the wet a touch

presets.name: Fuzz wall stereo wash
presets.desc: Deep anti-phase stereo chorus after fuzz, never ducked: chords smear into a wide, warm wall
presets.notes: Modulation Custom only to cancel Guitar Drive's attack ducking (env_mix 0); other values restate the Dual mode anchors

presets.name: Blooming ambient clean chorus
presets.desc: Slow, wide chorus ducked on the pick attack: notes start clear and bloom into movement as they sustain
presets.notes: Envelope ducks wet and depth on attacks (needs Modulation Custom; the rest restates Classic anchors, drift up a little)

presets.name: Electric piano chorus
presets.desc: Warm BBD chorus on electric piano, lows kept dry and centred: the 70s-80s soul and fusion keyboard sheen
presets.notes: Classic single-voice topology through the Keys profile (crossover 100 Hz, no emphasis, a little hiss)

presets.name: Bass chorus, lows untouched
presets.desc: BBD chorus on the mids and highs only: below 200 Hz stays dry and mono, the top end shimmers
presets.notes: Bass profile: crossover 200 Hz, wet low-pass 4 kHz, narrower mono-safe stereo; good on pick bass and chorded lines

presets.name: Fretless studio chorus
presets.desc: Clean digital-style chorus wobble on fretless bass: singing, vocal-like slides with a firm, dry low end

refs.song: Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)
refs.why: Pino Palladino's fretless line, recorded with Eventide and AMS chorus

presets.notes: Color Custom: clean engine for the 80s rack-digital character instead of BBD; lows still split at 200 Hz by the profile

presets.name: String machine ensemble
presets.desc: Three BBD voices on slow and fast three-phase LFOs: the lush, swirling string-machine ensemble
presets.notes: Ensemble mode: 3 voices, 0.6 Hz + 6 Hz LFOs, 30 % imperfection; also turns a 12-string or organ into a string pad

presets.name: Discreet vocal double
presets.desc: Two randomly wandering voices about 18 ms late at a low mix: a subtle double-track without periodic wobble
presets.notes: Doubler mode: smoothed random paths, no LFO cycle to hear; Voice profile ducks the wet slightly on syllable attacks

presets.name: Worn tape chorus
presets.desc: Chorus on a tape-style line with wow, flutter and hiss: a wobbly, nostalgic, slightly unstable clean tone
presets.notes: Color Custom: Tape engine; wow and flutter add irregular drift on top of the LFO, hiss follows the playing

presets.name: Fast rotary-like warble
presets.desc: Wet-only BBD voice at 5 Hz with a short swing: a fast vibrato-chorus that hints at a spinning speaker
presets.notes: Crossfade law at mix 1.0 = wet only, so it is a vibrato; gfx-rotary is the real speaker model
